messages:
samir_patel: Heads-up 1: Enterprise prospect Vaultify wants to start a 2-week POC but legal redlined the KMS answers in the questionnaire. They specifically require offline key ceremony support + proof of HSM attestation. What minimal artifacts do we need to unblock the POC?

tayla_chen: Minimal for POC: (a) allowlist for their outbound firewall, (b) a scanned copy of the HSM attestation or vendor-signed cert, (c) a short matrix: key types used (RSA-2048 / EC P-256), wrapping alg, and whether keys are exportable.

kevin_lo: Ops notes: We can offer a staged POC: Stage A - Redwood-managed keys (fast) for functional tests; Stage B - proxied BYO-HSM with attestation for security tests; Stage C - full offline ceremony for Prod. Call out perf impact for proxied ops ~8-15ms per crypto call depending on cross-AZ hops.

samir_patel: Procurement Q: do we charge for the offline ceremony coordination?

tayla_chen: Yes. One-time onboarding fee covers the coordinator + dry-run. Also monthly connector for the HSM proxy if they keep BYO in POC. I'll attach the pricing snippet.

kevin_lo: Security-bot rule: require FIPS 140-2/140-3 attestation or equivalent. Also ask them to confirm rotation policy (example: rotate KEKs every 90 days, CMKs yearly). Paste the snippet they can drop in the questionnaire.

kevin_lo: ```Please include: (1) vendor attestation cert (signed); (2) high-level key lifecycle diagram showing generation, wrapping, rotation frequency; (3) the exact allowlist (CIDR + ports) your network team will add.```

samir_patel: I'll send the questionnaire excerpt + allowlist template and offer the staged plan. Also scheduling note 1: if artifacts arrive by Mon EOD we can do firewall test Tue and dry-run ceremony Wed.

security-bot: Reminder: add SSO access list for the ceremony observers (ids required).

tayla_chen: Added. Will follow up with pricing and timeline in the thread. :rocket:
